en.headline: Yellow work heat warning issued on National Day
en.dek: The Labour Department put the yellow Heat Stress at Work Warning in force at 11.30am as the Observatory kept the Very Hot Weather Warning up and temperatures reached about 35 degrees.
body: The Labour Department issued a yellow Heat Stress at Work Warning at 11.30am on Thursday, National Day, and reminded employers and employees to take heat-stroke precautions while the warning remains in force.

The department said workers outdoors or in indoor spaces without air-conditioning face higher heat stress. Employers should assess heat-stress risk against workload and, so far as reasonably practicable, arrange rest breaks each hour according to the warning level, following the Guidance Notes on Prevention of Heat Stroke at Work.

The Hong Kong Observatory said the Very Hot Weather Warning, first issued at 11.15am on 28 September, remained in force. Its midday bulletin said temperatures over parts of the territory rose to about 35 degrees around noon, with mainly fine weather apart from isolated showers and a chance of isolated thunderstorms later.

A yellow Fire Danger Warning issued at 6am also remained in force. The Observatory forecast the northeast monsoon to affect the eastern Guangdong coast overnight, with heavier showers in some areas on Friday and high temperatures easing.

zh.headline: 國慶黃色工作暑熱警告生效
zh.dek: 勞工處今日上午11時30分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，天文台酷熱天氣警告持續，部分地區中午氣溫約35度。
body: 勞工處今日國慶上午11時30分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，提醒僱主及僱員在警告生效期間採取防暑措施。
勞工處表示，戶外或沒有空調的室內工作環境熱壓力較高。僱主須按《預防工作時中暑指引》，評估勞動量及其他熱壓力因素，並在合理地切實可行情況下，按警告級別每小時安排適當休息。僱員如出現頭痛、頭暈、口渴或惡心，應立即到陰涼處休息飲水並通知管方。
天文台指出，9月28日上午11時15分發出的酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。正午天氣稿指本港部分地區中午氣溫升至約35度，大致天晴，間中有驟雨，稍後有幾陣雷暴。
早上6時發出的黃色火災危險警告亦持續生效。天文台預料東北季候風今晚逐漸影響廣東東部沿岸，明日部分地區驟雨較多，高溫情況會緩和。
